decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 2 - The occupants of the dwelling shall be limited only to persons referred to the owners by the London Borough of Hounslow, and shall be limited to no more than 6 persons at one time

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the submitted plans, the front garden shall be reinstated and shall not used for parking, the existing concrete forecourt shall be broken out and replaced with a lawn and a front wall of no greater than 0.6m shall be erected along the front garden, within two months of the date of this decision and permanently retained thereafter.

Condition : 4 - A bin store or sealed refuse bins shall be provided within the rear garden within 1 month of this decision and permanently retained thereafter. No refuse shall be stored in the front garden and refuse shall be removed every day from the property by the visiting domestic staff and this refuse shall then be disposed of in a manner which shall first be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority within two months of the date of this permission.
Condition : 5 - The existing detached garage on the site shall be permanently retained and made permanently available for parking by residents of the premises and shall be used for no other purpose.

Condition : 6 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions, the continued use of the premises for temporary residential accommodation for up to six homeless persons satisfies an established demand for accommodation within the Borough without harm to the living conditions of surrounding residents or highway safety and is therefore acceptable in accordance with adopted Unitary Development Plan Policies ENV- B.1.1 (All New Development), H.3.4A (Houses in Multiple Occupation) and ENV-P.1.3 (Surface Water Run Off).
description: Change of use from house to house in multiple occupancy
